stdout: (no config - demo: the channel guide for a fictional company with a large first-year contract, a named account list, a small paid budget and a founder willing to write)
Which channel should we start with?
Start with: founder-led outbound to named accounts
Then add industry events and in-person communities once the first is predictable.
1. First: Founder-led outbound to named accounts
Pick the accounts, score them for fit, and have a founder start conversations with the few people who own the problem.
- ICP Fit Scorer: https://aajconsult.com/tools/icp-fit-scorer
- ABM Playbook: https://aajconsult.com/playbooks/abm-playbook
2. Second: Industry events and in-person communities
Go where the few hundred accounts you want already gather: one or two industry events and communities, with meetings booked before you arrive.
- ABM Playbook: https://aajconsult.com/playbooks/abm-playbook
- Webinar Pipeline Planner: https://aajconsult.com/tools/webinar-pipeline-planner
Test it before you commit
- Set your pass mark first: the most you can pay per qualified meeting or activated trial, from your margin and payback target.
- Fix a budget and a window, usually four to eight weeks.
- Measure the next step, not clicks: qualified meetings, activated trials, pipeline created.
- Unit Economics Calculator: https://aajconsult.com/tools/unit-economics-calculator
- Which marketing channels should a startup start with?: https://aajconsult.com/blog/which-marketing-channels-first
Leave alone for now
- A product-led motion, until people can reach value without a call.
Why
- You can name the accounts and the contract is large enough to pay for a conversation-led motion.
These rules are judgement, not benchmarks. Check them against your own numbers.

cases.name: hire guide, seed stage
cases.source: input written from the engine header schema
stdout: Do we need a marketing hire, and which one?
Hire a senior part-time leader to find the first channel
The job is to find one channel that repeats. That takes judgement more than hours.
1. A fractional head of marketing
Someone who has found channels before, for a set number of days a month, with a clear goal: one channel you could predict next month.
- Marketing Leadership Cost Comparator: https://aajconsult.com/tools/marketing-leadership-cost-comparator
- Fractional marketing leadership: https://aajconsult.com/services/fractional-marketing-leadership
Leave alone for now
- Hiring a channel specialist. You don't know which channel yet.
Why
- Positioning is settled but no channel repeats yet, so the scarce thing is experience in choosing and testing channels.
These rules are judgement, not benchmarks. Check them against your own numbers.
